_comment: Plain-language edits to authored exercise prompts, applied by ex_lib.dump. Each exercise id maps to [old, new] pairs; old is matched with any whitespace between words, since prompts wrap mid-sentence. The build fails if an old phrase is not found.
p01.001: Returning and printing are different things, and almost everything you write from here on returns.
p01.008: Write the loop yourself this time, even though a formula exists.
Use a loop, not the formula.
p01.016: write the branch yourself so you see what `get` is doing.
p01.026: Catch the exception rather than testing for zero first, so you see how `try` reads.
Catch the exception instead of testing for zero first.
p02.001: Do not use a generator - the point is to see what a generator is doing underneath.
p02.002: Because it is lazy, an endless generator costs nothing until you take values from it.
